questions.column: Who We Are and How It Works
questions.title: What is Achology?
questions.short_answer: An online applied psychology academy: 28 courses across seven schools, a community, and certification.

questions.column: Who We Are and How It Works
questions.title: Who is Achology designed for?
questions.short_answer: Reflective, self-directed adults: helpers, professionals, and people learning for their own growth.

questions.column: Who We Are and How It Works
questions.title: Is Achology accredited?
questions.short_answer: Yes, by SoMAP, whose committee of Master Achologists checks every claim on the accreditation pathway.

questions.column: Who We Are and How It Works
questions.title: How do Achology courses work?
questions.short_answer: Self-paced videos, reflective exercises, community practice, and included membership months.

questions.title: Where should I start with Achology?
questions.short_answer: Free events to try it, a course for a clear goal, membership to explore: match the start to you.

questions.title: Which course should I take first as a complete beginner?
questions.short_answer: Beginner entry points run $97 to $299, from the Masterclasses to the DiMAP diploma.

questions.title: How much does Achology cost?
questions.short_answer: Courses run $97 to $299, school bundles $987 to $1,337, and the Access All Areas Pass is $2,995.

questions.title: Does Achology offer a free trial or introductory rate?
questions.short_answer: Yes, there is a free membership tier plus a $7 first month of full Achology Membership.
